IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is running hot with 119 calls and nearly 933 hands needed—massive board. Miller Electrical and Inglett & Stubbs are both stacking bodies into QTS Fayetteville data center builds at **$42/hr**, conduit and cable tray work, predominantly inside JW slots. Book depth looks thick but the sheer volume means steady pushes if you're mobile.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is the pay-play standout. Veca Electric's got 20 Inside JW slots on Meta 3&5 Idaho at **$65.33/hr** with an incentive program and OT premium—that's real money and a draw for serious tramps. OEG's Micron job runs **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible, over 75+ miles), PLA work, raceway and wire pulling. Only 24 calls but 191 hands means competition; Book 1 moves quick here.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** has eight calls and 190 hands packed tight—data center surge in the area. ArchKey's Google West Memphis gig pays **$38.25/hr** with **$250/day** incentive per diem, day shift 6am start, 6/10s, OT double time. Cache Valley's main Memphis job runs **$15/hr over scale** with double-time OT. Night shift options exist (Copperhead, **$10 over scale**) if days are locked. Tight board but aggressive rates.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** features 54 calls, 368 hands, all Port Washington data center work. Gurtz and Cupertino Electric are both pulling 70 and 30 Inside JW respectively at **JW wage + $10/hr**, 58–60 hrs/week, drug test required. This is high-hours, high-premium work; repost flags mean turnover or fast pace.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** has 66 calls, 196 hands, tightest ratio on this board. Eli Lilly projects dominate—Industrial Electric's K153 Southside pays **$53.90/hr**, 6–10s Mon-Sat. Ermco's Lebanon temperature-control job is 5–10s, specialty-flagged. Tight book, specialized work, solid wages.

Data center build-out is eating the map—AWS, Meta, Google, QTS, Micron. Hands are chasing scale and per diem into the upper Midwest and Southeast, leaving smaller locals lean.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** — This board is *firing*. Ten calls, 92 hands on the bench, and Veca Electric's Meta 3&5 gig is sitting at **$65.33/hr** with an incentive program and OT premium pay. That's the hottest single rate on the entire board today. OEG's got two Micron jobs (Inside and Telecom/VDV) at **$45.33/hr**, both throwing **$170/day per diem x 7 days if eligible** — travel pay's real here. Quality Electric rounds it out on Micron IDX at the same **$45.33/hr** with **$20/hr travel pay** baked in. PLA work, solid per diem, and the Micron campus is popping. Book depth at 9-10 deep means you're not waiting.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** — Nine calls, 81 hands—this is the work right now. Cache Valley and Rosendin are both staffing the Llano project (Amarillo and Claude) with Inside JW at **$52.30/hr**, **$40/day per diem**, with OT double time on a 58/58/50 schedule. Twenty slots per contractor, 18-20 positions available. Cache Valley's also running a CW/CE crew on the same job. Classic data-center ramp-up: straight hours, clear work, no mystery.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** — Seven calls, only 31 hands—tight board. NABCO's running shop calls and the Chickamauga Dam Lock Project on a 4/10 schedule. Day and Zimmermann's got an augmented TVA Watts Bar Nuclear Outage call (crane ops, current TVA quals required). Adman's hiring for shop work with orientation Monday, October 12. No posted scale here, but the TVA work and nuclear outage gigs draw experienced linemen every cycle.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** — Twenty-six calls, only 31 hands—insane ratio. Northern Powerline's JBER runway airfield lighting at **$57.44/hr**. Golden Valley EI&C tech roles hit **$51.54–$60.63/hr** on a brutal 12hr 7/7 schedule in Healy. This is Alaska work: isolated, premium hours, thin board. If you can handle the dark and the distance, the slots are open.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** — Seven calls, 19 hands. Diadao's Trans Pole Yard job in Romney, WV stands alone at **$126/hr**, climbing required. EJ's Frederick substation work at **$56.35/hr** with **$150 per diem** and a need for two Subtechs. Le Myers transmission in Culpeper at **$55/hr**, **$150 per diem**. High-voltage transmission is moving in the Mid-Atlantic corridor.

**Market snapshot:** Data-center and transmission load is pulling hands into the Southwest (Amarillo), Northwest (Boise), and remote sites (Alaska). TVA nuclear maintenance and Mid-Atlantic transmission keeps the Southeast ticking. East Coast rates lag West Coast by $8–12/hr on comparable work.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, October 6, 2026**

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is the board to watch this week — 6 calls, 36 hands needed, and the work is solid industrial. Gem's got combo welders testing into their fab shop (bennies don't pyramid here, so know what you're walking into). Graham's running Cenovus maintenance for pipefitters, but you'll need current DISA card and height quals. Nooter's also on the Cenovus fab shop side with **$125/day** per diem and incentive pay — DISA cert required again. The no-beard rule at BDO's fab shop call is tight, but these are real hands-on fabrication gigs, not sitting-around-waiting work.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 5 calls, 28 hands, and the Denver metro is moving. US Eng. Metalworks wants stainless experience in their shop. Murphy's Corden Pharma Boulder job offers **$125** per diem if you're over 100 miles out, plus 15% incentive pay — that's the kind of sweetener that moves people. Power Source Services needs combo welders with rigging cert or rigging experience at JM Shafer station in Fort Lupton. Real variety here; book depth should be manageable.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is lean at 2 calls, 3 hands, but both are substantial. Bechtel's Cheyenne Power Hub is looking for journeyman pipefitters with HDPE fusion experience and offering **$125/day** per diem for days worked if you're 75 miles out. PMI's Fort Meade VA Hospital in Sturgis, SD, needs a UA-21 welder with OSHA10 and a clean background — **$100/day** per diem.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** has one call: CAM at Irving Oil Refinery with shutdown incentives and a test-on job for F3/F4 welders — if you chase Atlantic work, this is live right now.

Power and industrial maintenance are consolidating calls; the DISA requirement and rigging certs are the gatekeepers.
